api.title: API & skill for agents
api.subtitle: Anything you can click in the UI, you can also do over REST – e.g. Claude as the judge rating answers.
api.skill.title: Skill for Claude
api.skill.intro: The repo ships a ready-made skill: .claude/skills/llm-eval/SKILL.md. Fire up Claude Code in the project folder (or copy the skill to ~/.claude/skills/) and say something like:
api.skill.prompt: rate all unrated iterations in LLM Eval as "Claude Judge"
api.skill.note: The skill creates its own bot user, pulls iterations in blind mode and hands out stars with a justification.
